overview: An automated Gmail management system built with n8n to organize incoming emails, apply the right labels, route messages to the appropriate team, and prepare replies as drafts.
The system handles inbox processing automatically while keeping final control over outgoing emails with the team.

list: Checks whether an email has already been processed
Categorizes emails based on their content and priority
Identifies emails that require a response
Generates draft replies using company information
Routes emails to the relevant team member
Creates properly formatted Gmail drafts with subjects and signatures

blocks.p: The workflow uses a knowledge base to provide relevant information when preparing replies.
Emails are also routed based on their category, ensuring messages reach the appropriate department or team member.

result: A streamlined email management system that reduces manual inbox work, keeps emails organized, routes messages correctly, and prepares consistent replies while keeping the final sending decision with the team.
